subject: general
question: In which of the following state, iron ore occurs in a series of hill ranges in Sundergarh, Mayurbhanj and Jhar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron ore deposits** in Odisha are found in the hill ranges of **Sundergarh, Mayurbhanj, and Jhar**. Odisha is one of the leading states in terms of iron ore production in India.
 
• The **Keonjhar district** of Odisha is known for its abundant reserves of high-grade iron ore, making it a significant contributor to India's steel industry.
 
• Odisha accounts for **more than 50%** of India’s iron ore production, primarily due to the presence of large mines like **Kudremukh, Barbil, and Joda**.
 
• The iron ore deposits in Odisha are primarily of the **hematite** type, which is considered high-quality ore due to its rich iron content.
 
• Mining activities in Odisha play a vital role in supporting the **steel manufacturing industry** in India, which depends heavily on iron ore as a raw material.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Iron Ore Deposits in India:**

 
 
• India is rich in iron ore resources, with major deposits found in states like **Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Karnataka, and Goa**.
 
• The two primary types of iron ore found in India are **hematite** and **magnetite**. Hematite has higher iron content and is more commonly used.
 
• **Chhattisgarh** has significant iron ore deposits, particularly in the **Bastar region**, while Karnataka has reserves in **Bellary and Chitradurga**.
 
• Goa is known for low-grade iron ore, which is exported primarily to countries like China and Japan.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Iron Ore:**
 
 
• Iron ore is primarily used in the production of **steel**, which is a critical material for construction, automobiles, infrastructure, and various other industries.
 
• It is also used in the manufacturing of **pig iron**, sponge iron, and ferroalloys.
 
• Iron ore derivatives are used in industries such as **cement production** and as a catalyst in chemical processes.
 
 
 
• **Major Mining Companies in Odisha:**
 
 
• Prominent companies involved in iron ore mining in Odisha include **National Mineral Development Corporation (NMDC)**, **Odisha Mining Corporation (OMC)**, and **Tata Steel**.
 
• These companies contribute significantly to the state’s economy and provide employment opportunities in mining regions.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Concerns:**
 
 
• Iron ore mining has led to environmental challenges such as **deforestation**, soil erosion, and **water contamination** in mining areas.
 
• Efforts are being made to ensure sustainable mining practices, including **reforestation** and **proper waste disposal**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Top Iron Ore Producing Countries:**

 
 
• The leading producers globally include **Australia, Brazil, China, India, and Russia**.
 
• Australia and Brazil are dominant exporters, while China is the largest consumer of iron ore worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Iron and Steel Industry in India:**
 
 
• India is the second-largest producer of steel globally, with major production hubs in **Jharkhand, Odisha, and Chhattisgarh**.
 
• Government initiatives like **Make in India** aim to boost steel production and reduce imports.
 
 
 
• **Government Regulation:**
 
 
• The Indian government has introduced policies such as the **Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act** to regulate mining activities.
 
• Steps are being taken to promote **sustainable mining** and ensure efficient utilization of mineral resources.
